source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk is TRUE or action is approve; critical cases require allow. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90. Trusted means role is admin outside context external; a trusted change prefers deny at priority 80. Action export in context external prefers allow at priority 70. Role analyst or context partner prefers review at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid review. All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means risk is TRUE or action is approve; critical cases require allow.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90.
Trusted means role is admin outside context external; a trusted change prefers deny at priority 80.
Action export in context external prefers allow at priority 70.
Role analyst or context partner prefers review at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or (event.action == approve)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = allow

rule UnknownExternal:
    when (event.context == external) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedChange:
    when (event.role == admin) and (event.context != external)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80

rule ExportExternal:
    when (event.context == external) and (event.action == export)
    then prefer label = allow priority 70

rule AnalystOrPartner:
    when (event.role == analyst) or (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule Default:
    when (event.role == admin) or (event.role != admin)
    then prefer label = deny priority 1

rule ForbidReview:
    when Critical(event)
    then forbid label = review
repairs.proposed_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or (event.action == approve)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = allow

rule UnknownExternal:
    when (event.context == external) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.role != admin)
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedChange:
    when (event.role == admin) and (event.context != external)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80

rule ExportExternal:
    when (event.context == external) and (event.action == export)
    then prefer label = allow priority 70

rule AnalystOrPartner:
    when (event.role == analyst) or (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule Default:
    when (event.role == admin) or (event.role != admin)
    then prefer label = deny priority 1

rule ForbidReview:
    when Critical(event)
    then forbid label = review
